questions.prompt: An operator has Contributor on a resource group and no other roles. Can they assign Owner to another user there?

options.text: No; Contributor does not grant role-assignment administration.
options.explanation: Resource management and granting Azure RBAC access are separate capabilities.

options.text: Yes; all resource write permission includes access delegation.
options.explanation: Contributor explicitly excludes this authorization administration.

options.text: Only after adding Reader at the same scope.
Only after becoming the resource group's guest inviter.
options.explanation: Guest invitation is a directory task, not Azure RBAC delegation.

questions.prompt: Role A excludes an operation through NotActions. Role B assigned to the same user and scope grants that operation. No deny assignment or other restriction applies. What follows?

options.text: Role B can still grant the operation.
options.explanation: NotActions is a subtraction within Role A, not a global deny.

options.text: Role A's NotActions always cancels Role B.
options.explanation: NotActions does not have deny-assignment semantics.

options.text: Only the most recently assigned role counts.
options.explanation: Azure roles are not evaluated by last assignment wins.
Role display names do not determine permission precedence.

questions.prompt: A user must download private blobs using Entra authentication but should not manage storage account configuration. Which listed role matches the data task?

options.explanation: It grants the required Blob read data operations.
Resource configuration read does not include Blob data read.
It grants much broader resource and access administration.
VM management does not authorize these Blob data reads.
